d: Short-cut, mahogany-brown hair with choppy bangs and a slight wave frames a youthful, child-like face with large, wide-eyed reddish-brown eyes. A petite, slender build is dressed in a white short-sleeved sailor shirt with a dark green collar, paired with a pleated dark green mini-skirt and matching dark green tights.
